assumptions.execution: Hypothetical fills omit latency, market impact, liquidity and queue position.
assumptions.missingMinutes: Only shared observed close timestamps are scored; per-asset histories retain separate observed minutes, never filled.
assumptions.spread: Assumed historical bid/ask; not observed executable quotes
assumptions.timestamps: Candle bucket start +60 seconds; actual publication latency not modeled.
assumptions.warmup: Only frame.history includes pre-start observations; eight observations needed for default trend, 241 for maximum lookback.

evidence.storage: Compact prices and raw responses preserve source evidence. Frames expose lazy history views; export evidence instead of JSON-stringifying all frames.
